hypotheses.justification: The statement does not require discreteness to elaborate. Compactness and the topological-group assumptions give LocallyCompactSpace G, without requiring Hausdorffness. Rebuild swapCoind as uncurrying, precomposition by coordinate swap, then currying; rebuild diagonalCoind as uncurrying followed by precomposition by t ↦ (t,t). Their continuity follows from ContinuousMap.continuous_uncurry, continuous_precomp and continuous_curry in Mathlib/Topology/CompactOpen.lean, with no discreteness assumption on the codomain. Thus insertCoind and coind₁Insert can be constructed recursively without the discrete-topology instances. Their pointwise formulas, equivariance and homotopy proofs remain unchanged, and the displayed homology argument then applies unchanged. The lemma π_surjective also has no discreteness assumption. These constructions and identities work for trivial coefficient modules and trivial groups as well; no nontriviality or separation assumption is needed.
